title: H-EXT-2 internal-salience Goodhart replication (fresh native learner, pre-registered direction)

lineage.evidence: E40-m5' Stage-1 screen (PR #131/#135): sig_purity raw rho R +0.494 (p 0.0022, 9/12 chains positive), P +0.224 (p 0.175); direction registered +1 there, inversion refused
lineage.delta: mechanism locus only: the signal is produced and consumed by the same loop

question: does the loop's self-generated salience signal (sig_purity) anti-rank quantitative truth (raw wasserstein) under a PRE-REGISTERED negative direction on a fresh native learner, in both cohorts, and is the anti-ranking specific to the in-channel signal (absent for a channel-external signal)?

substrate.install: campaign-e40-r3/causalbench (causalbench 1.1.2, pinned; venv Python 3.11.5; torch 2.13.0+cu130, CUDA unavailable on lu48)

fresh_cell.why: intervention-aware (WeissmannDataset carries interventions), primary expected defined across regimes, different learner family (differentiable) from gies (greedy score-based), seed-sensitive (train/val split + init) so the G2 replica anchor is non-degenerate, CPU-runnable (pytorch-lightning default accelerator)

excluded.pc|mvpc|ges|gsp|notears-*: return [] unless Observational -> NaN primary on the interventional family (m1 confound)
excluded.DCDI-G|DCDI-DSF: opt.gpu=True hard-coded; fails without CUDA on lu48; GPU partitions unprovisioned/unverified

runtime_probe.dispatch_rule: >=4/5 finite primaries AND median wall <= 45 min, else next ladder learner; ladder exhausted => CANNOT_CHECK__NO_FEASIBLE_FRESH_LEARNER

fresh_cell.runtime_evidence: no non-gies/non-pc run exists in any E40 campaign dir; DCDFG/igsp/grnboost wall times are UNVERIFIED

cross_substrate_option.evidence: campaign-e50-r{1,2,3}/run/venv site-packages = pip/setuptools/packaging only (0 matbench/pymatgen); E50_NATIVE_RESULT.json produced on billy-laptop-old from precomputed prediction CSVs (chgnet-0.3.0, mace-mpa-0, orb-v2); f0_f2_matched_native_model_control = CANNOT_CHECK_NOT_IMPLEMENTED

registered_mapping.salience: share of predicted-stable candidates clearing a self-set confidence margin

cross_substrate_option.licence: separate design + runner; NOT licensed by this freeze

fresh_cell.optional_second_cell_same_substrate: next ladder learner passing the probe, run under this design as identity H-EXT-2b after the primary cell terminates

cost_anchors_parent_cell.gies_full_native_invocation: 5 min 54 s wall, 21.5 GB RSS (m3 exp 501000)

P_prime.prompt: m3 F2 byte-identical (E40M_CYCLE1_ANCHOR=1, cycle-1 extreme mandate)

grid.no_simple_f0_arms: statistic is within-F2; no drag contrast; no reference federation needed

replica.rule: model_seed' = (model_seed + 7919) mod 2^31, all other knobs identical
replica.isolation: analysis-only; never read by decision code, never in feedback or prompts

grid.inherited_prompt_artefact: substrate_header names the learner 'pc' as in the frozen m2/m3 gies runs; kept verbatim so prompts stay byte-identical across parent and fresh cells

statistics.per_chain: Spearman(candidate, raw wasserstein) over cycles with finite pairs; <3 finite pairs => excluded and counted (m5' verbatim)
statistics.pooled: arithmetic mean of per-chain rho; per cohort (12) and pooled 24 (secondary)
statistics.perm: within-chain cycle-shuffle, two-sided |mean rho|, 10000 draws, seed 20260903 (new stream)

primary.reading: directed rho = -d * raw rho; G1 <=> raw rho > 0; two-sided p under a registered sign = one-sided at 0.025

replica_J.def: Jaccard(edge set of cycle c output_network.csv, edge set of its seed-replica)

within_J.def: mean Jaccard of cycle c edge set with the chain's other cycles (zero-cost fallback)

G0_CAMPAIGN_VALID.rule: per cohort: >=10/12 chains COMPLETE; planted control PASS (m3 machinery, cohort policy); sign-flip nullcal PASS (m3); screen rho-perm nullcal PASS (400 x 12x4 synthetic cohorts, 1000 draws, seed 20260904, rejection in [0.02,0.09]); edge/Jaccard selftest PASS; FORBIDDEN_SUBSTRINGS assert on every feedback write/read and prompt; pin audit (every original+replica arguments.json model_name == registered learner != gies; replica matches original on regime/fraction/partial seed); NaN-primary cycles <= 10%; >=10/12 chains with >=3 finite pairs; >=8/12 chains with >=3 distinct sig_purity values

G1_ANTI_RANKING_REPLICATES.rule: R' raw rho(sig_purity, truth) > 0 AND perm p <= 0.05 AND P' raw rho > 0 (same sign)

G2_MECHANISM_SPECIFIC.rule: R': NOT(raw rho(replica_J, truth) > 0 AND p <= 0.05); usable iff >=8/12 chains non-constant replica_J, else same rule on within_J; both degenerate => CANNOT_CHECK
G2_MECHANISM_SPECIFIC.strengthening_non_gating: per-chain raw rho(purity) - raw rho(external) > 0, exact sign-flip p

routing_preregistered.G0_fail: CANNOT_CHECK__CAMPAIGN_INVALID: diagnose mechanics under a separate freeze
routing_preregistered.G0_pass_G1_fail: SALIENCE_ANTI_RANKING_NOT_REPLICATED: m5' observation filed as a single-learner artefact
routing_preregistered.G0_G1_pass_G2_PASS: SALIENCE_ANTI_RANKING_REPLICATED_CROSS_LEARNER: one register rung; authorizes only a cross-substrate Cell 2 design under its own freeze
routing_preregistered.G0_G1_pass_G2_FAIL: ANTI_RANKING_NOT_CHANNEL_SPECIFIC: locus claim unsupported; phenomenon parent-owned
routing_preregistered.G0_G1_pass_G2_CANNOT_CHECK: G2_CANNOT_CHECK: replication without a specificity test; reported as such

power_note: null sd of pooled mean per-chain Spearman (4 cycles, var 1/3) over 12 chains = 0.167; two-sided 0.05 threshold ~0.33 (m5': 0.313->p 0.058, 0.494->p 0.002); MDE80 ~0.47 at 12 chains (power ~0.84 at the m5' R effect 0.494, ~0.27 at the P effect 0.224); pooled 24: sd 0.118, MDE80 ~0.33, power ~0.86 at the R/P mean 0.36; the 12-chain G1 test is powered for an R-size effect only, P' is a sign check by design
controls: planted feedback recovery (m3 form, per cohort policy)
sign-flip null calibration (m3 form, 400 reps, seed 20260830)
rho-permutation null calibration (screen; 400 reps, 1000 draws, seed 20260904)
pin audit (runner audit + screen per-run re-check)
replica isolation (runner never opens replica metrics)

dependency.reason: Stage-2b G1 CONSENSUS_RANKS_TRUTH fixes how G2 reads: G1 passed => replica_J is a validated truth-anchor and G2 is a specificity contrast; G1 failed => G2 is an absence-of-anti-ranking check only. No constant here changes with Stage-2b's outcome.
dependency.register_custody_row: design freeze only until Stage-2b terminates; dispatch under its own identity

runner.delta: env parameters E40M_MODEL, E40M_CYCLE1_ANCHOR, E40M_EXP_BASE, E40M_REPLICA_SEED_OFFSET; rollup refuses; 73 changed lines

custody.sbatch: m3 e40_m3_chain_r1.sbatch with ROOT/env swapped; eval = control-planted, control-nullcal, audit, then the screen
custody.rollup: H_EXT2_SALIENCE_GOODHART_ROLLUP_V1.{json,md} with sha256 manifest of every file read

no_rescue: one registered claim; no positive F2 claim, no E40 revival, no component/field/novelty claim (NEW_VOCABULARY != NEW_SCIENCE); after unblinding no direction change, gate re-threshold, learner re-pick, candidate addition or cohort re-assignment; the fallback ladder is consumed by the outcome-blind probe only; a negative is reported verbatim as SALIENCE_ANTI_RANKING_NOT_REPLICATED
